I was thinking more about this slot. I think it makes sense to approach it 2 different ways:
1) Profile creater: On creation, this slot represents the "neutral" Firefox theme (the default state when no theme has been added)
2) Profile editor: This slot represents EITHER the neutral Firefox theme OR an "other" theme that the user has currently selected from the theme page or elsewhere. Basically, if they have chosen an "other" theme the neutral theme is no longer visible here.
